title: 第10章 变卖账号
slug: 七天后穿越我提前囤货躲灾年
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

谭筝老实交代：“因为缺钱……”

“咱们一路打拼，从寥寥数人走到现在第一帮派，这份江湖情谊，难道在你眼里就这么不值一提？”青峰痛心疾首。

谭筝无奈：“我也舍不得大家，可情怀再重，也当不了饭吃啊。”

青峰似乎是被她气到了，再没弹出消息来。

谭筝继续关注交易页面，希望有人能看上她的号。

得益于是老玩家，该完成的主线、支线，还有隐藏任务她都完成了。

加上这些年参加活动获得的绝版道具，下池子抽出的神级装备，还有大佬偶尔转赠的礼物，估摸着也能卖个几万块。

在输入价格的时候，谭筝犹豫了。

定什么价格合适呢？

忽然，她灵机一动，在交易金额那一栏输入了二十万。

点击发布后，没几分钟就引来了路人的围观。

“这人疯了吧？？？这种号撑死就值个三万块，她竟然敢挂二十万？！”

“是不是把别人都当成傻子了？谁会花二十万买这么个破烂回去？”

“截图投墙了，明天在网络奇葩行为鉴定上必有你的一席之地。”

谭筝看着网友们的评论，笑得嘎嘎乐。

她当然不会蠢到以为自己的游戏账号值二十万，她这么做，纯粹只是为了提高曝光。

这不，目的达到了。

谭筝打算再过个半小时，就把价格调成三万块，争取今天就把账号给卖出去。

【已有买家拍下您的账号，请前往确认交易】

什么？！

谭筝有些傻眼了，这可是二十万啊？哪个神人眼花，少看了一个零不成？

不对啊！

竟然能够付款成功，就说明对方确实有二十万！

大款来着的啊！

不仅是谭筝，其他还在看热闹的路人们也炸开了锅。

“有没有搞错啊？真的有人拍啊？”

“不是，大哥，我的号比她的好，要不您看看我的呗？”

Page (1/3)

Tan Zheng confessed honestly: "Because of lack of money..."

"We have worked hard all the way from a handful of people to the largest gang now. Is this friendship in the world so insignificant in your eyes?" Qingfeng lamented.

Tan Zheng was helpless: "I can't bear to leave you all, but no matter how sentimental I am, I can't eat them as food."

Qingfeng seemed to be angry with her and no more messages popped up.

Tan Zheng continued to pay attention to the transaction page, hoping that someone would take a fancy to her account.

Thanks to being an experienced player, she has completed all the main plots, side plots, and hidden tasks that need to be completed.

In addition to the out-of-print props obtained from participating in events over the years, the god-level equipment extracted from the pool, and the occasional gifts given by bosses, it is estimated that it can be sold for tens of thousands of yuan.

When entering the price, Tan Zheng hesitated.

What price is appropriate?

Suddenly, she had an idea and entered two hundred thousand in the transaction amount column.

After clicking publish, it attracted the attention of passers-by within a few minutes.

"Is this person crazy??? This kind of account is worth 30,000 yuan to death, but she dares to pay 200,000 yuan?!"

"Do you think everyone else is a fool? Who would spend 200,000 yuan to buy such a piece of junk?"

"The screenshot has been uploaded to the wall. You will definitely have a place in the Internet Weird Behavior Appraisal tomorrow."

Tan Zheng looked at the comments from netizens and laughed happily.

Of course she would not be stupid enough to think that her game account was worth 200,000. She did this purely to increase her exposure.

No, the purpose was achieved.

Tan Zheng plans to adjust the price to 30,000 yuan in another half hour and try to sell the account today.

[A buyer has taken a photo of your account, please go and confirm the transaction]

What?!

Tan Zheng was a little dumbfounded. This was two hundred thousand?What god is so dazzled that he misses a zero?

That’s not right!

The payment was able to be successful, which meant that the other party did have two hundred thousand!

It’s a big money guy!

Not only Tan Zheng, but other passers-by who were still watching the excitement also exploded.

"Is there any mistake? Someone really filmed it?"

"No, brother, my number is better than hers, why don't you take a look at mine?"
